_note: Every Higgsfield image prompt for the Hola Ola site. {PREAMBLE} and {CAN} are replaced with the shared blocks below so the look stays identical across assets. The three film prompts live in film-day.txt, film-burst.txt and film-crack.txt. Generate the golden-set can first: it is the reference for everything else.
preamble: Photoreal premium beverage advertising photograph, natural tropical daylight, full-frame camera, crisp specular highlights on cold aluminum, fine condensation droplets, sun-washed clean grade with soft film grain. Brand palette: sand cream #FFF3DC, turquoise #19C2B8, coral #FF6B4A, mango #FFB627, deep ocean teal #0A3A44. No people, no hands, no watermark.
can: A slim 12 oz (355 ml) aluminum soda can with a matte printed label, a brushed-silver top rim and a pull tab. Label layout, exactly: solid {BASE} background. Upper half: the wordmark in two stacked centered lines, 'HOLA' above 'OLA', in thick, rounded, slightly slanted retro surf-poster lettering, colored {INK}. Directly under the wordmark, small widely spaced capitals: '{NAME}', and under that in smaller capitals: '{SUB}'. Lower third: three bold flat wave bands rolling from left to right in {WAVE1}, {WAVE2} and cream #FFF3DC, with a small flat {SUN} sun disc resting on the top wave. At the very bottom in tiny capitals: 'SPARKLING BEACH SODA'. No other text, no barcode, no nutrition panel.

can_render.prompt: {PREAMBLE} Product hero shot. {CAN} The can stands upright, label square to camera, perfectly centered and fully in frame with clear space on every side, isolated as a clean cutout on a fully transparent background with no ground shadow. Even softbox light from upper left, gentle rim light on the right edge, a light mist of condensation droplets. 85mm lens, f/8, every letter on the label tack sharp and correctly spelled.
can_render.reference_suffix: Same can, same layout and the same lettering style as the reference image. Change only the colors and the flavor text as specified.

keyframes.day_start: {PREAMBLE} Wide cinematic frame, 16:9. Ultra-low angle with the lens a few centimeters above the sand at the waterline of an empty tropical Pacific beach, minutes before sunrise. Dead center of the frame, one slim aluminum soda can identical to the reference image stands upright, sunk a little into mirror-wet sand, label square to the lens and perfectly sharp. The can is small: about one fifth of the frame height. A thin sheet of sea foam is sliding back toward a calm, glassy ocean behind it. Sky: soft pastel gradient from lilac to peach with a faint glow on the horizon directly behind the can, no sun yet. Leaning coconut palm silhouettes only at the far left and far right edges. Calm empty space to the left and right of the can. 35mm lens, deep focus. No footprints, no birds, no text other than the can label.
keyframes.day_end: {PREAMBLE} Wide cinematic frame, 16:9, same beach and same lens axis as a dawn shot, but now the camera is close and it is night. One slim aluminum soda can identical to the reference image stands upright in mirror-wet sand, dead center, label square to the lens, tack sharp, filling about seventy percent of the frame height. Deep indigo sky dense with stars and a faint milky way, a hairline of ember orange on the horizon. Small waves breaking behind and beside the can glow electric blue with bioluminescence, lighting the foam and reflecting in the wet sand. Soft warm firelight from off-screen left touches the left edge of the can, cool blue rim light on the right edge. Condensation droplets glitter. Dark, calm, uncluttered space to the left and right of the can. 35mm lens, deep focus. No text other than the can label.
keyframes.burst_start: {PREAMBLE} Wide cinematic frame, 16:9. Low angle at can height at the waterline of a tropical beach at midday. One slim aluminum soda can identical to the reference image stands upright in a few centimeters of crystal-clear water over pale sand, dead center, label square to the lens, tack sharp, about forty-five percent of the frame height. Hard overhead tropical sun, bright turquoise sea and a clean blue sky behind, caustic light patterns rippling on the sand under the water, tiny wavelets around the base of the can. Calm empty space to the left and right of the can. 50mm lens, deep focus. No fruit, no splash, no text other than the can label.
keyframes.crack_start: {PREAMBLE} Macro photograph, wide 16:9 frame. The top of one cold slim aluminum soda can seen from a high three-quarter angle: brushed-silver lid, closed pull tab, the top rim and just the upper edge of a mango-orange body, all beaded with condensation droplets. The lid sits in the center of the frame. Golden-hour backlight from a low sun, the sea behind dissolved into warm orange and turquoise bokeh. 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, focus on the pull tab. No label text visible anywhere.

elements.suffix: Isolated as a clean cutout on a fully transparent background with no shadow on the ground, bright even studio light with one warm sun-like key from upper left, everything tack sharp, nothing cropped by the frame edges. No text.

logo_mark: Minimal flat vector emblem for a beach soda brand: a solid sun disc sliced through its lower third by one thick rolling wave line that curls at the right end. Single color, deep ocean teal #0A3A44, on a plain white background. Thick rounded shapes, generous spacing, reads clearly at 24 pixels. No text, no letters, no gradients, no outline box.
